newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices mixed, volume up.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices mixed, volume up.

text.p: Prices were mixed on the Istanbul gold exchange on Tuesday, but volume jumped to 898 kilos from Monday's 535.
The bulk of trade was in the morning, with 833 kilos.
Dealers said this was due to banks engaging in arbitrage deals to benefit from rising dollar rates in the domestic currency markets and falling world gold prices.
Gold closed at $358.30 an ounce, down from $360.10 on Monday, following world trends. It rose in lira terms to 1,291,700 lira per gram from a previous 1,289,600 as the lira weakened.
The lira fell to a low of 111,900 against the dollar from Monday's 111,550 close before firming to 111,750 at the close on minor central bank intervention.
Dealers said the lira's recovery in the afternoon reduced the profitability of arbitrage deals and caused volume to dive.
Of the 898 kilos of trade, 78.8 percent was in lira terms.
